title: Ampleness characterized by a basis of nonvanishing loci
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. For $n\geq1$ and $s\in\Gamma(X,L^{\otimes n})$, let $X_s$ be the open set where the residue-field value of $s$ is nonzero, as in [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]; tensor powers use [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Then $L$ is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] if and only if these opens form a basis for the topology of $X$: for every open $V\subseteq X$ and every $x\in V$ there exist $n\geq1$ and $s\in\Gamma(X,L^{\otimes n})$ with $x\in X_s\subseteq V$. No affineness of the opens $X_s$ in this basis condition is assumed, and no Noetherian or separatedness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 01Q3, proposition-characterize-ample, equivalence of (1) and (3) (item-ample and item-s-basis).

proof.text: Assume $L$ is ample. Fix an open $V\subseteq X$ and $x\in V$. By [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], the positive-power section opens cover $X$, and there are $d\geq1$ and $a\in\Gamma(X,L^{\otimes d})$ with $x\in X_a$ and $X_a$ affine. Put $S=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\Gamma(X,L^{\otimes n})$. Apply [lem-sc-ample-proj-local-chart] to this cover: its canonical map $f:X\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ has $f^{-1}(D_+(t))=X_t$ for every positive-degree homogeneous $t$, and $f|_{X_a}:X_a\to D_+(a)$ is an isomorphism.

The isomorphism of Step 1 sends $V\cap X_a$ to an open subset $W$ of $D_+(a)$, hence an open subset of $\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ containing $f(x)$. By [lem-sc-proj-standard-open-basis], choose a positive-degree homogeneous $t\in S_n$, $n\geq1$, with $f(x)\in D_+(t)\subseteq W$. By the inverse-image formula in Step 1, $x\in X_t=f^{-1}(D_+(t))$. Since $D_+(t)\subseteq D_+(a)$, every point of $X_t$ lies in $X_a$; on $X_a$ the isomorphism identifies the preimage of $W$ with $V\cap X_a$. Thus $x\in X_t\subseteq V$. The element $t\in S_n$ is a global section of $L^{\otimes n}$, as required.

source.place: Tag 01Q3 (proposition-characterize-ample), first paragraph: (2) implies (4) implies (3); positive-degree standard-open refinement is Algebra Tag 00JP (lemma-topology-proj), (5).

proof.text: Conversely, assume the stated basis condition. For $x\in X$, use [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis] with the open $X$ to choose an affine open $U$ containing $x$. The assumed basis condition provides $n\geq1$ and $s\in\Gamma(X,L^{\otimes n})$ with $x\in X_s\subseteq U$. By [lem-sc-affine-cap-section-open], applied to this positive tensor power and the affine open $U$, the intersection $U\cap X_s$ is affine. But $U\cap X_s=X_s$, so $X_s$ is an affine section neighbourhood of $x$.

source.place: Tag 01PX (lemma-affine-s-opens), proof, used for (3) implies (1) in Tag 01Q3; Tag 01PV (lemma-affine-cap-s-open).

proof.text: The scheme $X$ is quasi-compact by hypothesis. Step 3 gives an affine nonvanishing locus of a positive-power global section through every point. These are precisely the two conditions defining ampleness in [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Thus $L$ is ample, completing both implications.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01Q3 (proposition-characterize-ample), equivalence (1) and (3), using the affine charts of 01Q1, the standard-open basis of 00JP, and 01PX/01PV for the reverse implication.
